say:2:1421109001:1.text: Hmm, these commoners do seem friendly enough. Have you gained any inspiration from their feedback?
say:2:1421109001:1.source_cn: 唔，这些平民看起来倒是挺友善的，也有问必答，不过，能满...

say:3:1421109002:1.text: The people wanted poetry to be more straightforward and relatable... That might make your teachers faint on the spot.
say:3:1421109002:1.source_cn: 要是让你的文法老师听见那些“直白简单”“通俗易懂”之类...

say:4:1421109003:1.text: Haha! No need to test my resolve, Xera! Their suggestions really helped!
say:4:1421109003:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，不用试探我啦，席蕾，我非常感谢他们给我提供的意见...

say:5:1421109004:1.text: What Sal'thorin really needs right now is simple and exciting works that resonate with the common folks!
say:5:1421109004:1.source_cn: 现在的萨洛克兰，就是缺少一些足够让大家都兴奋起来的，足...

say:6:1421109005:1.text: If I can create something like that, it'll surely boost everyone's morale!
say:6:1421109005:1.source_cn: 如果我能做出平民也喜闻乐见的作品，一定能提振整个萨洛克...

choice_prompt:7:1421109005.text: If I can create something like that, it'll surely boost everyone's morale!
choice_prompt:7:1421109005.source_cn: 如果我能做出平民也喜闻乐见的作品，一定能提振整个萨洛克兰的精神！

say:8:1421109006:1.text: Yes! I wanted to write about the daily routines of commoners at first, but it's tricky without any personal experience.
say:8:1421109006:1.source_cn: 嗯！我本来想写平民的日常生活，但我确实没有相关的切身体...

say:9:1421109007:1.text: So, I shifted my focus to a Sal'thorin hero with a humble background!
say:9:1421109007:1.source_cn: 所以我打算中和一下，写一位平民出身的英雄，萨洛克兰真实...

say:10:1421109008:1.text: A name just popped into my mind.
say:10:1421109008:1.source_cn: ……你这样说的话，我眼前已经浮现出一个名字了。

choice_prompt:11:1421109008.text: A name just popped into my mind.
choice_prompt:11:1421109008.source_cn: ……你这样说的话，我眼前已经浮现出一个名字了。

say:12:1421109009:1.text: That's right! I'm going to write about Indris. Everyone knows that he's trying to lead the people of Sal'thorin toward a new and brighter future!
say:12:1421109009:1.source_cn: 没错！就是如今萨洛克兰所有人的梦想与光辉，为我们带来全...

say:13:1421109010:1.text: To learn more about him, let's begin with his life as a commoner!
say:13:1421109010:1.source_cn: 首先，我们就从他还是平民时期的生活开始吧！

choice:7:1:2.text: Have you decided on the theme?
choice:7:1:2.male: Have you decided on the theme?
choice:7:1:2.female: Have you decided on the theme?
